noAccess.title: No groups to maintain
noAccess.text: Groups are maintained here by the people who manage them. To manage a group, contact the ZWR or whoever manages it already.

list.title: Groups
list.intro: Groups whose members are maintained here: people, other groups and rules for whole address ranges, each with a role and, if wanted, until a date.
list.introAdmin: All groups of the source {{source}}. Groups from other sources (e.g. bwIDM) are maintained there and can be entered here as members.

create.title: Create group
create.idHint: Becomes the token group:<identifier> by which rules name the group; cannot be changed later. Lowercase letters, digits, dot, hyphen and underscore.
create.idInvalid: Only lowercase letters, digits, dot, hyphen and underscore, starting with a letter or digit.
create.managersHint: People or groups allowed to maintain the members. Managing is not being a member.

delete.title: Delete group?
delete.message: {{id}} is deleted with all its entries and removed from every other group. Rules in the services that name group:{{id}} no longer apply.

entries.hint: A group as entry makes all of its members members of this group, in the chosen role. An entry with an end date counts until the end of that day.
entries.removeMessage: {{member}} loses the role “{{relation}}” in this group.

expiry.title: Change end date
expiry.hint: Without a date the entry does not end. An expired entry counts again with a new date.

effective.hint_one: {{count}} person belongs to this group in the end, sub-groups included and expired entries not. Whoever belongs only through an address pattern is not listed.
effective.hint_other: {{count}} people belong to this group in the end, sub-groups included and expired entries not. Whoever belongs only through an address pattern is not listed.

managers.hint: Whoever manages a group maintains its entries, its description and who manages it. Managing is not being a member: nobody gains the group's rights by it.
managers.removeMessage: {{manager}} can no longer manage this group.
